prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a bustling snowy town square filled with distinct characters and objects. In the center stands a large stone fountain covered in a thick layer of white snow. To the left of the fountain, a woman in a blue coat holds a steaming cup of coffee while looking at a man in a green hat who is pointing toward the sky. Next to the man in the green hat, a black cat sits on a wooden bench, observing a brown dog that is sniffing a red mailbox nearby. On the right side of the scene, a child in a yellow jacket is handing a small gift box to an elderly woman in a purple shawl. Behind them, a street musician in a gray beanie plays a violin for a crowd of three listeners: a boy in an orange scarf, a girl with pigtails, and a man holding a newspaper. Above the musician, a string of colorful triangular flags hangs between two lampposts. Near the foreground, a vendor in a striped apron stands behind a cart selling roasted chestnuts, handing a paper bag to a customer in a pink beret. A bicycle leans against the cart, its wheels partially buried in snow. In the background, a clock tower rises above the rooftops, its face showing three o'clock. A pigeon flies near the clock tower, while another pigeon perches on the edge of the fountain. A snowman with a carrot nose stands next to the fountain, wearing a top hat. A sled lies abandoned on the ground near the snowman. A shop window displays mannequins wearing winter coats. A bus stops in the distance, with passengers visible through the windows. There is no sun in the sky. There is no text on any signs. There is no water flowing in the fountain.
